nodes.name: Surface Stockade & Guard Tower
nodes.customNotes: Fortified timber stockade guarding the elevator headframe leading into the subterranean iron complex.

nodes.name: Mine Level 1: Slave Barracks & Sorting
nodes.customNotes: Choking dust and clanking chains where hundreds of enslaved miners toil under brutal guard whips.

nodes.name: Mine Level 2: Subterranean Canal & Sluice
nodes.customNotes: An underground river channeling water to hydraulic lift wheels, containing the master flood sluice plug.

nodes.name: Mine Level 3: Yeslick's Dungeon & Armoury
nodes.customNotes: Dark, flooded holding cells where the dwarven clan cleric Yeslick Orothiar is kept in chains.

nodes.name: Mine Level 4: Davaeorn's Arcane Lair
nodes.customNotes: A lavish subterranean suite protected by battle horrors, guard slime, and Davaeorn's dimension-door teleport traps.
